# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Eight years old  <sub>[v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c27 P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Second-primer schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is an attractive young boy with a round skull covered in tiny, fuzzy yellow ringlets. He has a snubbed nose, a perpetually smiling mouth, and a single dimple in one cheek that gives him a sweet, amusing appearance when he chuckles. His eyes dance with elfish roguishness, and his face reflects joy and playfulness.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009)_

## Personality

Robin is naturally mischievous, good-humored, and actively inquisitive, frequently asking questions that perplex adults. Although he is somewhat careless, prone to forgetting his responsibilities, and easily distracted, he possesses a natural charm that makes him very affectionate and easily comforted. He approaches activities like gardening and games with great enthusiasm rather than careful judgment.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c25 P41](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0041)_

- Mischievous  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030)</sub>

## Abilities

- Untangling nets and collecting cord spheres  <sub>[v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- Wants to become a shopkeeper and stock candy and bananas  <sub>[v2 c14 P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031)</sub>
- Wants an Indian headdress made of rooster feathers  <sub>[v2 c22 P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016)</sub>

## History

After the death of their mother, Robin and his twin sister Lucy were taken from East Welby by their third cousin once removed, Thirza Abernethy, to reside at Grey Shutters. During the carriage ride home, his restless antics caused Thirza considerable anxiety until he bear-hugged her in response to her threat of a whipping. Shortly after his arrival, Robin established a strong devotion to Nell Harcourt and a mild rivalry with Chester Mott and Cedric Stanhope. His constant inquisitiveness and mischievous pranks—such as searching the well for darkness, plucking rooster feathers, and falling into lemon pies—kept the household busy. In the spring, Thirza gave Robin and Lucy small garden plots, though Robin worked his with more energy than success. He eventually began attending school, forming a friendship with his desk partner Milty Gammon and finding great enjoyment in his studies.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 c9 P22](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0022), [v2 c14 P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- His father passed away shortly after his birth  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- Raised initially in East Welby by his mother Mary, who suffered persistent poor health until her death  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c18 P11](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0011)</sub>
